name: Ministral 3 14B Instruct 2512
definition: Ministral 3 14B Instruct 2512 is an open-weight Ministral 3 model by Mistral AI focused on higher-capability local chat, vision and instruction following.

architecture.context: Up to 262,144 in published generation configuration

license.name: Apache 2.0
license.commercial_use: Review exact official terms before production.

hardware.summary: Workstation/local class. Mistral documents 32GB VRAM BF16 and less than 24GB RAM/VRAM when quantized.

deployment.summary: Mistral publishes vLLM/mistral-common support and multiple precision variants.
deployment.eu_eea_self_hosting: Technically possible when the complete stack is operated on EU/EEA infrastructure.
deployment.data_residency: Provider origin does not determine data residency.
